description: 13-jurisdiction margins with donor_flat as the base scenario and stumpage_scaled as the sensitivity.

decision.reason: v1 flat BC donor is the consistent base. The v2 stumpage-scaled proxy is a method sensitivity because dues/royalties are not delivered prices and are not comparable to the donor.

stumpage_ratio.formula: BC delivered price / BCTS average stumpage rate
stumpage_ratio.scope: BC blended Coast+Interior; BCTS does not publish a regional stumpage revenue/volume split in the materialised source.

licensing.statement: No strict-open claim is made. Provincial rate pages, PDFs and spreadsheets are public-reference copyrighted sources. Only extracted rates, URLs and hashes are redistributed; source documents are not.
